text: The Fozola Applied Research Lab includes members Pinhan Bilfael, Leveine Brarpil, Nasomel Sonmerett, Garhoel Thaterona, Hindas Brukruan, and Kidasa Branilen. It owns Project Vatuen, Project Drugilett, and Project Stukoett, and has developed the Lozenor Lattice and the Sestan Loom. The lab is responsible for data retention tooling and works out of the Vurlekri Annex.
